q6_slipping_through_cracks.curator_notes: Every item passes both tests: real consequence plus a burial factor (bounce, attachment-only, quote-only, misleading subject, auto-responder, bcc). The hardest call was the ambiguous-pronoun abandoned-cart case, which the trap matrix marks as Q6 material: it is excluded here because Ben's Aug 8 'Cart Abandonment Flow — Live!' closes it, and opening a closed obligation is a worse error than omitting a planted one. Priyanka's Jul 20 media-list request also died in an auto-responder, but it is scored as a low-stakes Q4 borderline rather than a crack. The three bounces are counted as three distinct failures because they are three different recipients and three different messages.
